ios.desc:
Umkreisel – Everything You Need on the Go, in One App

Rediscover your surroundings: Umkreisel shows you all the important places around you at a glance – whether it’s affordable gas stations, camper van parking spots, playgrounds, public toilets, showers, water refill stations, WiFi hotspots, parking lots, and much more. Plan your trip, road trip, or everyday life easier than ever before – spontaneously or in advance.

Many apps in one:
With Umkreisel, you no longer need separate apps for finding toilets, comparing fuel prices, defibrillator locations, parking spot finders, free WiFi maps, second-hand shops, and more. Everything you really need on the go is collected and easily accessible in one single app.

Over 100 map filters for every purpose – Customize your map with individual filters and always see exactly what you need. All categories and filters are clearly organized:

• Mobility:
Gas stations (including LPG), EV charging stations, car rentals, car sharing, auto repair shops, bicycle parking, e-bike charging, bicycle repair stations, bicycle tube vending machines, bike rentals, boat rentals, motorcycle parking, parking lots, bus stops, train stations, taxi stands, car washes

• Public Services:
Public toilets, free WiFi, water refill stations, showers, trash bins, mailboxes, luggage lockers, dog waste bag dispensers, laundromats, tourist information

• Safety & Emergency:
Shelters, police stations, fire extinguishers, defibrillators, lifebuoys

• Finance:
ATMs, banks, currency exchange offices

• Health:
Pharmacies, hospitals, baby hatches, doctors, dentists, veterinarians

• Seating:
Benches, picnic spots, reclining benches, lookout towers

• Leisure:
Viewpoints, sights, mountain peaks, waterfalls, playgrounds, fire pits, Kneipp pools, libraries, public bookshelves, cinemas, swimming pools, saunas, castles, museums, botanical gardens, zoos, trampoline parks, go-kart tracks, bowling alleys, clubs, dancing, escape rooms, golf, mini golf, ice skating, beaches, volleyball nets, basketball courts, football fields, table tennis tables

• Food & Drink:
Bars, beer gardens, cafés, food courts, fast food, ice cream shops, pubs, restaurants

• Shopping:
Bakeries, drugstores, supermarkets, kiosks, shopping centers, department stores, hardware stores, food vending machines, florists, bookstores

• Sustainability:
Second-hand shops, organic stores, marketplaces, village shops, food sharing, farm shops, zero-waste stores

• Accommodation:
Hotels, motels, guest

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

I love exploring new places, whether that’s a weekend trip, a bike ride, or a night of stargazing. But I always felt frustrated with common map apps—they’re great for directions, but not for showing the things I actually care about.

I often found myself jumping between different apps for different purposes - even tho they share similar maps. Each has a different design/UX or annoying ads and personally I just don't like that. So for example one app for gas prices, another for public restrooms, a third for camper sites and yet another ones for weather, rain radar, or light pollution (for night photography).

So I decided to build my own map app:
With Umkreisel, you can combine any background map (like satellite, topographic, or cycling) with real-time data layers—like rain radar & clouds, wind speed, UV index, air quality, pollen, Saharan dust, realtime traffic, temperature, bathing water quality, wave height, light pollution, aurora forecast, day/night overlay and more.

You also get 100+ categories of useful points of interest—from public toilets and showers to playgrounds, bike repair stations, free WiFi, farm shops, and even defibrillators.

It’s been a really interesting journey building this (and I’ve learned a ton along the way). I’d love to hear your feedback—whether you’re a camper, cyclist, photographer, or just someone who wants better, more useful maps.
